name: Song, Jin and Western Xia: 1141 map reference

properties.attribution: Ian Kiu, Jinn and Sung Dynasties 1141 (2007), CC BY 3.0; traced and geographically registered by World History Atlas

note.en: Approximate 1141 outline adapted from Ian Kiu’s map after a 1935 historical atlas, shown as a fixed dated reference; it is not an annual reconstruction. Boundaries and influence could change within the display period. Geographic registration and the small source image add uncertainty.
note.zh: 依据Ian Kiu参考1935年历史地图集绘制的1141年概略轮廓，作为固定年代参照，并非逐年复原。显示期间边界与影响范围可能变化；地理配准和原图分辨率带来不确定性。

sources.title: Jinn and Sung Dynasties 1141, original 2007 version
sources.evidenceNote: Ian Kiu’s CC BY 3.0 map, based on Albert Herrmann’s 1935 atlas. The original 2007 version was extracted, georegistered, and generalized. The later replacement versions were not used.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: Ian Kiu依据Albert Herrmann 1935年历史地图集绘制，采用CC BY 3.0许可。本图提取2007年原版并进行地理配准和概括，未使用后来的替换版本。

sources.title: Frontier Walls, Trenches, and Forts in Mid-Jin Politics, 1161–1208
sources.evidenceNote: Documents the 1165 Song–Jin peace and cautions that a precise northern Jin border is not evidenced. It does not establish the map vertices.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 记述1165年宋金和议，并指出金朝北部缺少精确边界证据；并未核实本图的边界顶点。

sources.title: Song in a Multipolar World
sources.evidenceNote: Explains the sequence from Northern Song to Southern Song, the Jurchen Jin and the Mongol conquest; it does not validate the drawn border.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 概述北宋、南宋、女真金朝与蒙古征服的先后顺序；不验证绘制的边界。

Boundaries and influence could change within the display period. Geographic registration and the small source image add uncertainty. The source image cuts off the northeastern part of Jin, and northern frontiers were not precise fixed lines.
note.zh: 依据Ian Kiu参考1935年历史地图集绘制的1141年概略轮廓，作为固定年代参照，并非逐年复原。显示期间边界与影响范围可能变化；地理配准和原图分辨率带来不确定性。 原图截断金朝东北部，北方边疆也并非精确固定的界线。
